name: MON PATCHOULY
description: A rich and highly original fragrance that beautifully раскрывает the rebellious, free spirit of patchouli. The composition will undoubtedly appeal to creative, passionate, and unconventional personalities. Ramon Monegal about the fragrance: “Inspired by the raw scent of patchouli leaves that I discovered together with hippies in the 1960s on the island of Ibiza, it became the first olfactory image that defined the attitude: provocation and freedom. Mon Patchouly became refined, enriched with poetic sea sunsets that can be watched from Café del Mar; it draws you in and wins you over with its ability to convince and seduce everyone around.”

name: AQUA NYMPHAE
description: The delicate and fresh AQUA NYMPHAE fragrance opens with a light whisper of reed and citrus notes. A cool wave of the top notes and the heart of the fragrance smoothly blends into a woody base, where vibrant papyrus is accented with subtle pepper. This original LE COUVENT composition is like a spring dream in the shade of majestic trees. It evokes dreams, inspires contemplation, and transports you to a floral garden, reminding you of the power of nature—both gentle and untamed. An expressive fragrance created from natural botanical essences, produced in the traditions of French haute perfumery.

name: FORT ROYAL
description: The oriental spicy fragrance FORT ROYAL, where the vanilla-creamy facet of benzoin and a fresh, shimmering accord of wild berries unfold vividly, is dedicated to the rich exotic nature of the Caribbean islands. The amber and gourmand character of this refined composition invites an escape to the edge of the world, offering a sweet and warm feeling of relaxation. This LE COUVENT eau de parfum, developed in the traditions of French haute perfumery, is created from noble essences and dedicated to the travels of the famous French botanist Louis Feuillée.

name: UN DEUX TROIS SOLEIL
description: French BASTILLE eau de parfum is made from natural ingredients. The bright and playful oriental fragrance UN DEUX TROIS SOLEIL awakens warm childhood memories: afternoon games with friends on a sunny day or family celebrations filled with sweet treats. Carefree moments are brought back by playful gourmand notes familiar from early years: almond, vanilla, and multifaceted tonka beans. Their sweetness is softened by radiant citrus notes, heliotrope, and benzoin. Perfumer: Domitille Michalon-Bertier.

name: JADE
description: Somens represents the union of humans and the universe through fragrance. A talisman embodying the inexhaustible life energy of the earth and the materialization of ideas. Jade, translated from Latin, means jade stone — the vital force of nature that brings us back to our origins. Base notes of sandalwood and cedar gradually unfold behind the light floral-fruity tones of gardenia and bergamot. Through the jade talisman, this special connection grants wisdom and knowledge, allowing one to reconnect with nature and feel the strength needed to live in harmony and unity with it. Perfumer: Luca Maffei — a French perfumer, third generation of a perfumery dynasty, creator of fragrances for Amouage, Nishane, Givenchy, Carolina Herrera, and many other mainstream and niche brands.

name: BACCARAT ROUGE 540
description: Baccarat Rouge 540 eau de parfum was created through a collaboration between Maison Francis Kurkdjian and Baccarat to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the crystal manufacturer. A woody accord creates a poetic alchemy, forming a luminous olfactory composition. Airy notes of jasmine and radiant saffron are complemented by mineral amber notes and woody facets of freshly cut cedar. Expressive and elegant, Baccarat Rouge 540 eau de parfum envelops the skin in an amber, woody-floral whisper.

name: MUSC RAVAGEUR
description: Musc Ravageur was launched in 2000 and marked a new milestone in the history of amber fragrances. The creator of this sensual, deep, yet perfectly balanced, captivating and mysterious composition is Maurice Roucel. He conceived Musc Ravageur as an “act of seduction and generosity,” and this uncompromising amber fragrance confidently stands against all myths and trends. Musc Ravageur opens with an explosive accord of bergamot, mandarin, and cinnamon, which then gives way to vanilla, musk, and amber. It is a sensual fragrance that embodies a dangerously rebellious spirit.

name: MORNING CHESS
description: A clear, carefree morning in a country house, a battle over the chessboard — Ian’s memories of summer holidays spent at his grandfather’s home. Lush summer greenery on the Swedish seaside, light nuances of freshly cut grass that on a warm summer day recall the contrasting freshness of winter air. A game of chess framed by accords of bergamot and patchouli.

name: EPIC WOMAN
description: Spicy sparks of pink pepper merge with the warm spice of cinnamon and cumin, then rise to the very heart, where they shine in the radiant glow of a mythical rose. Among its delicate petals drifts a lemony nuance of geranium. The spices soften, giving way to the intoxicating strength of jasmine. It enhances the rose theme with floral and fruity accents, while fresh, humid tea notes run through the composition like rays of sunlight. Upon a pedestal of dry iris, guaiac wood, and patchouli, incense reveals its mineral facet touched with dusty oud. Finally, warm currents of sandalwood, luxurious amber, and Madagascar vanilla envelop everything in a golden glow, crowned by a powerful note of pure white musk. EPIC WOMAN, inspired by the legends of the Silk Road, is a spicy amber fragrance that blooms magnificently in mysterious twilight somewhere between China and the Arabian Peninsula.
base_notes: amber, musk, oud, incense, guaiac wood, iris, sandalwood, patchouli, vanilla

name: BLACK VETIVER & AMBER
description: An intricate olfactory book whose story unfolds in new facets on every person. Unusual note combinations and an original construction of accords emphasize individuality and reveal essence more vividly than any words. All Zielinski & Rozen fragrances are unisex.

name: BALI HAI
description: A siren’s whisper carried by a gentle sea breeze. The creamy coconut note and marine breeze in BALI HAI evoke waves softly caressing the tropical shores of the mythical island of Bali. Approaching twilight with breathtakingly colorful sunsets is embodied in notes of rose and jasmine. A gourmand vanilla accord creates a mysterious yet familiar warmth, softened by gentle amber. An enchanting trail of soft woody and floral notes immerses us in a state of profound calm, filled with dreams of a beautiful future.

name: UNITED DREAMS LOVE YOURSELF
description: Benetton United Dreams Love Yourself eau de toilette is a fragrance that encourages every wearer to stay true to herself, to be unique, distinctive, and original. The composition features shades of sensual rose and the freshness of jasmine, complemented by pear notes, sweet-and-tart raspberry, apricot, woody nuances, and amber. Thanks to this combination, Love Yourself radiates passion and warmth paired with softness and an inherent sense of dynamism. Benetton added touches of bergamot, musk, and freesia so that every woman can experience the magic of this modern fragrance blend and feel truly unique.

name: SHAMAN
description: Shaman by MiN NEW YORK is a sensual love potion from the otherworld. It is offered by a mysterious sorcerer. A time traveler. A guardian of sacred forces. Violet leaf, mandarin, and cardamom lift the veil of mystery, allowing misty incense, nutmeg, labdanum, and rose absolute to emerge. The base of this mystical fragrance features ambergris, honey, and patchouli.

name: VANILLA VIBES
description: Juliette has a Gun Vanilla Vibes eau de parfum is a sensual fragrance with oriental nuances, created for confident men and stylish women. The original combination of powdery vanilla notes with the refreshing salinity of sea salt that opens Vanilla Vibes is beautifully complemented by the exotic orchid that unfolds in the heart of the composition. The refined trail of Juliette has a Gun eau de parfum is насыщен smoky facets of tonka beans intertwined with musky accents and the spiciness of sandalwood.

name: PETALI E SPADE
description: Petali e Spade perfume is dedicated to fragility not as a synonym for weakness, but as true inner strength. Awareness of one’s own vulnerability ignites an inner flame that leads us toward change and full self-discovery. This powerful NOBILE 1942 composition emphasizes the olfactory profile of a woman who, behind apparent fragility, conceals a fearless soul and graceful ferocity. The inspiration for its creation was Xiao Mei — a blind dancer, the main character of the film “House of Flying Daggers.” Her graceful movements are in fact endowed with explosive self-control: a hypnotic dance can turn into a deadly fight, when a branch becomes a lethal dagger and the bamboo forest a treacherous prison, an improvised weapon. The fragrance, built on aldehydic, fruity, and white floral accords, is dedicated to women like Xiao Mei all over the world. Inside every woman lives a warrior who moves forward with confidence even along unfamiliar paths, bends but does not break under life’s pressures, and prefers to walk alone in the dark rather than in someone else’s shadow.

name: BANIYAS
description: WIDIAN AJ Arabia Baniyas is an oriental-gourmand fragrance for men and women, dedicated to the remarkable richness and character of the Arabian Peninsula. The composition opens with a fresh blend of citrusy, slightly bitter bergamot, lavender, and the smoky-bitter nuance of artemisia. At its heart unfold accords of sweet balsamic geranium, velvety oud, and resinous coniferous cedar. The captivating melody is completed by a sensual, warm, and comforting trail of chocolatey patchouli, creamy sandalwood, and vetiver, subtly accented by herbaceous notes of oakmoss.

name: SAPPHIRE COLLECTION LONDON
description: Aj Arabia Sapphire Collection London perfume opens with the fresh note of cypress, closely intertwined with the elegance of violet and harmonious nuances of oud. At the heart of the Sapphire Collection London composition, delicate lily-of-the-valley notes and juicy raspberry accents emerge. In the trail, Aj Arabia perfume leaves animalic leather accords, complemented by spicy facets of amber, sweet vanilla, and musk.

name: MODERN NOMAD
description: The woody-leather fragrance Modern Nomad revives memories of carefree and pleasant journeys. A harmony of smoky notes of Japanese roasted Hojicha tea and amber, the subtle combination of patchouli and oud, and the sensuality of leather and vanilla unfold to make you forget about time. Modern Nomad becomes the perfect companion for a journey through life. A leather jacket, a cashmere scarf, and an unusual, captivating trail — this is what a modern nomad can be like, always ready for exciting change.
top_notes: hojicha tea, lapsang souchong tea, pu-erh tea

name: YUZU
description: SOLINOTES eau de parfum with a bright and invigorating yuzu note is a sparkling cocktail for a good mood. The inspiring and fresh yuzu fragrance is enhanced by other citrus fruits: playful lemon, zesty bergamot, and rich mandarin. This impressive fruity burst is softened by delicate white flowers, while patchouli and oakmoss add elegance to the composition. The eau de parfum can be layered with other fragrances from the brand to create a unique personal mix of favorite notes, or worn on its own to enjoy the vivid freshness of citrus.

name: THE CORA
description: The Drop of the Sun (Cora Sun-Drop Diamond) is the world’s largest pear-shaped yellow diamond. Its 110.3 carats of exceptional purity inspired the perfumers of Thameen to create the fragrance of the same name. How does this unique gemstone sound? The composition opens with bright splashes of jasmine and magnolia combined with notes of Bulgarian rose. This is followed by nutmeg and vanilla, while the trail leaves soft accords of amber, patchouli, and white musk. The Cora diamond is valued at 7 million euros. Thameen eau de parfum costs many times less, yet the effect is similar.
top_notes: clove, vanilla, lily of the valley, benzoin resin
